in_marathi.name: Ranjit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ranjit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ras-Jit', which means 'one who has conquered joy'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Krishna, who is known for spreading joy and happiness to all. The name carries the blessings of the divine, signifying a happy and content life.
